name: Bidoof
notes: Painted design: flat brown fur with a faint painted grain, a cream muzzle and belly stripe, dark-grey nose and paw pads, white incisors, red mouth.

So: short soft fur along the painted grain (gravity guess where the paint has no direction), slightly longer at island edges; nose and pads stay smooth leathery skin (painted grain only); teeth and mouth untouched.
Body shader 3436703351 is flocky-parametered but has no normal sampler: in game only _dif (strands, faint baked cavity) and _par (AO, roughness) load; Body_nor is cache-only.
